content: Tarewřa n Yaɛqub zi Laban
Uca isřa Yaɛqub awařen n iḥenjiren n Laban, nnan: “Yaɛqub iksi marra min tuɣa n babatneɣ u s min tuɣa n babatneɣ aqa ikseb marra aɛuǧi-ya.”
Ixzar Yaɛqub ɣar uɣembub n Laban. Xzar, war kides iǧi am iḍennaḍ d fariḍennaḍ.
Inna SIDI i Yaɛqub: “Dweř ɣar temmurt n řejdud nnec u ɣar řaǧ nnec. Aqa Necc ad iřiɣ akidek.”
Isekk Yaɛqub uca iřaɣa-dd x Raḥil d Liya ɣar yeyyar, ɣar wuǧi nnes.
Inna asent: “Ttwařiɣ belli aɣembub n babatkent war kidi iǧi am iḍennaḍ d fariḍennaḍ. Maca AREBBI n řejdud inu aqa-t akidi.
Kennint tessnent belli aqa xedmeɣ i babatkent s marra min ɣari d jjehd.
Maca babatkent iɣecc ayi, ibeddeř řmunet inu ɛecra n twařawin, maca AREBBI war d as isemmeḥ ḥima ad ayi igg řɣar.

Mařa netta inna: ‘Ibeqqiḍen ad iřin d řmunet nnec!’, řexdenni marra uǧi urwent-i-dd uǧi s ibeqqiḍen, mařa inna: ‘Inni s icariḍen ad iřin d řmunet nnec!’, řexdenni marra uǧi urwent-i-dd uǧi s icariḍen.
Ammu ikkes AREBBI řebhayem n babatkent uca iwca ayi tent i necc.
Imsar ɣar řweqt umi weḥḥment uǧi, ssgeɛɛdeɣ tamuɣři inu uca ẓriɣ di tarjit, aqa da iɣayḍen nni ineggzen x wuǧi, tuɣa aten s icariḍen d ibeqqiḍen d iqarqacen.
Inna ayi lmalak n AREBBI di tarjit ‘Yaɛqub!’ Necc nniɣ ‘Aqa ayi da!’
Inna: ‘Nḍar tiṭṭawin nnec, xzar, marra iɣayḍen, inni ineggzen x wuǧi, aqa aten s icariḍen d ibeqqiḍen d iqarqacen, minzi Necc ẓriɣ marra min d ac ittegg Laban.
Necc d Arebbi n Bayt-Il, mani tdehned aẓru n řidaret u mani d ayi tewcid awař. Kkar řexxu, ffeɣ zi temmurt-a, ɛqeb ɣar temmurt mani txeřqed.’”
Xenni arrint-i-dd Raḥil d Liya, nnant as: “Ma din ɛad ca n tesɣart niɣ ict n řwart i neccin di taddart n babatneɣ?
Ma war nettwiḥsib am tbarraniyyin? Aqa netta izzenz aneɣ u netta aqa iqeṭṭa marra nnuqart nneɣ.
Minzi marra agřa nni ikkes AREBBI i babatneɣ, nneɣ i iǧa u n iḥenjiren nneɣ. Řexxu ɛad, egg marra min d ac inna AREBBI.”
Xenni ikkar Yaɛqub uca issgeɛɛed iḥenjiren nnes d temɣarin nnes x iřeɣman.
Igga deg webrid marra řebhayem nnes d marra agřa nnes nni dd-ikseb, aqa řebhayem nni iṭṭef, inni dd-ikseb di Fadan-Aram, ḥima ad dd-iɛqeb ɣar Isḥaq, babas, di temmurt n Kenɛan.
Umi iruḥ Laban ɣar tiřsa n wuǧi nnes, tucar Raḥil řexyařat timeẓyanin n l’aṣnam n babas.
Yaɛqub ixdeɛ Laban, Aramiyu, řami war d as iɛřim aqa ad yarweř.
Yarweř s marra min ɣares. Ikkar, iẓwa iɣzar n Lfuraṭ uca yarra azeǧif nnes ɣar idurar n Jilɛad.
Deg wass wiss třata xebbaren Laban, aqa yarweř Yaɛqub.
Xenni yiwi aytmas akides, iruḥ awarni as ticři n sebɛa n wussan, ixecc xas deg idurar n Jilɛad.
Uca yusa-dd AREBBI ɣar Laban, Aramiyu, di tarjit di ǧiret, inna as: “Ɣarek ad tessiwřed s řxar niɣ s řɣar ak-d Yaɛqub.”
Ireḥḥeg xenni Laban x Yaɛqub. Yaɛqub tuɣa iwta aqiḍun nnes deg idurar. Laban ɛawed iwta iqiḍan nnes ak-d aytmas deg idurar n Jilɛad.
Xenni inna Laban i Yaɛqub: “Min teggid, teẓwid ayi uř uca tiwyid-dd yessi am tmeḥbas n garra?
Mayemmi tarewřed s tnuffra u tucared ayi u mayemmi war d ayi txebbared, ḥima ad cek ssqebbḍeɣ s řefraḥet, s řeɣnuj, s ubendir u s řgambri?
War d ayi tejjid ad ssudmeɣ iḥenjiren inu d tḥenjirin inu. Řexxu d tubbuheřya i teggid.
Ɣari tizemmar deg ifassen inu, ḥima ad cek ḍarreɣ, maca AREBBI n babatwem issiweř akidi ǧiret-a, inna: ‘Ɣarek ad tessiwřed s řxar niɣ s řɣar ak-d Yaɛqub.’
Uca řexxu tuyured, umi zeɛma tweḥḥced taddart n babac. Maca maɣar i d ayi tucared irebbiten inu?”
Yarra-dd Yaɛqub, inna i Laban: “Minzi tuɣa ggʷedeɣ, nniɣ ak-d yixef inu ad taɣ ad ayi tekksed yessic s uɣiř!
Ɣar wenni i ɣa tafed l’aṣnam nnec, ejj i-t war iddar ɛad! Qibač i wawmaten nneɣ ad tmeyyzed min iǧan nnec jar min iǧan ɣari uca awyi t akidek.” Maɣar Yaɛqub war issin belli Raḥil i ten yucaren.
Uca yudef Laban ɣar uqiḍun n Yaɛqub, ɣar uqiḍun n Liya, ɣar uqiḍun n tnayen n tiyya uca war yufi walu. Řami dd-iffeɣ zeg uqiḍun n Liya, yudef ɣar uqiḍun n Raḥil.
Maca teksi Raḥil řexyařat timeẓyanin n l’aṣnam, tegga i-tent deg iɣaynen n weřɣem uca teqqim xasen. Yarzu Laban deg uqiḍun am ikmeř, maca war yufi walu.
Tenna i babas: “War ittiři aya d řɣar di tiṭṭawin n sidi inu, minzi war zemmareɣ ad kkareɣ qibač nnec, maɣar aqa ayi s tnamit n temɣarin.” Uca yarzu, maca war yufi řexyařat timeẓyanin n l’aṣnam.
Xenni ixeyyeq Yaɛqub uca imcubbec ak-d Laban. Yaɛqub iṭṭef deg wawař, inna i Laban: “Mani iǧa uxeṭṭu inu? Man wen iǧan d ddenb inu, umi d ayi dd-teḍfared s zzɛaf?
Cek tbeqced marra řqecc inu. Min tufid zi marra řeḥwayej n taddart nnec? Egg i-t da zzat n yaytma d aytmac uca ejj i-ten ad ḥekmen jar aneɣ s tnayen.
Ɛicrin n iseggʷusa i kik kkiɣ. Tixeswin nnec d tɣayḍin nnec ɛemmarṣ ssutment niɣ ɛemmarṣ cciɣ icarriyen n wuǧi nnec.
War d ac iwyeɣ min ittwamezzqen, maca xeṭṣeɣ t simant inu. Min ittwacaren zzayi deg wass niɣ di ǧiret, aqa zeg ifassen inu tᵉttared t.
S uziř ittett ayi řeḥmu yuẓɣen tiřmect u s ǧiret ttejmideɣ zi sqiɛ, ařami yarweř iḍeṣ zi ɣari.
Ammu i d ayi tuɣa di taddart nnec ɛicrin n iseggʷusa. Xedmeɣ ɣarek arbeɛṭac n iseggʷusa x tnayen n yessic d setta n iseggʷusa x wuǧi uca tbeddřed řmunet inu ɛecra n twařawin.

Mařa AREBBI n baba, AREBBI n Ibrahim d tiggʷudi n Isḥaq, iři war kidi iǧi, d ṣṣeḥ iři ad ayi tessqaded řexxu s ifassen xwan! Iẓra AREBBI tamara d tumar n ifassen inu uca ideqmar i cek ǧiřet n iḍennaḍ.”

Yarra-dd Laban uca inna i Yaɛqub: “Tiḥenjirin-a d yessi u iḥenjiren-a d iḥenjiren inu, u uǧi-ya d uǧi inu, u marra min tᵉttwařid aqa inu. Min zemmareɣ xenni ad ggeɣ řexxu s yessi niɣ s iḥenjiren nsent nni urwent?
Ɣawer ɛad řexxu, ad negg ijj n řɛahd, necc d cek, ad yiři Netta d cchadet jar ayi d cek!”
Uca iksi Yaɛqub aẓru, issgeɛɛed i-t am weẓru n řidaret.
Uca inna Yaɛqub i yaytmas: “Smunem iẓra!” Ksin iẓra uca ggin taɛurrict uca ccin din x tɛurrict nni.
Uca igga Laban i uɛurric n iẓra nni ‘Jigar-Sahaduta’, maca Yaɛqub igga as ‘Jilɛad’.
Xenni inna Laban: “Taɛurrict-a ad tiři d cchadet ass-a jar ayi d cek!” X uya tegga as Jilɛad
d Miṣfa, minzi netta inna: “Iři SIDI ad iḥḍa jar ayi d cek, xmi ɣa niři am nᵉnuffar ijjen zeg wenneɣni.
Mařa tesseḥqared yessi niɣ ad tmeřced timɣarin nneɣni x yessi, am war din iǧi ḥed akidneɣ ḥima ad yiři d acehhad, aqa AREBBI ad yiři d acehhad jar ayi d cek!”
Inna ɛawed Laban i Yaɛqub: “Xzar, taɛurrict-a n yeẓra, xzar, aẓru n řidaret nni ssbeddeɣ jar ayi d cek.
Taɛurrict-a n yeẓra d weẓru-ya n řidaret ad cehden belli necc war ɣarek dd-ẓekkʷiɣ ca x tɛurrict-a uca uřa d cek war ɣari dd-tẓekkʷwid ca i řɣar x tɛurrict-a uřa x weẓru-ya n řidaret!
AREBBI n Ibrahim d AREBBI n Naḥur, aqa AREBBI n babatsen, ejj i-t ad iḥkem jar aneɣ!” Maca Yaɛqub ijjuǧ s ‘Tiggʷudi n Isḥaq babas’.
Xenni iɣarṣ Yaɛqub i yict n tɣarṣt deg idurar uca iřaɣa i yaytmas ad ccen aɣrum. Uca ccin aɣrum, senssen ǧiret nni deg idurar.

footnotes.text: Jilɛad- isem wanita ixs ad yini ‘tawrirt n cchadet’.
Miṣfa- isem wanita ixs ad yini ‘lburj i uḥettu’.
